{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99')
print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = (df['status'] == 'refunded')
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}')

# Check for converted customers
converted_mask = (df['converted'] == 1)
print(f'Number of converted customers: {converted_mask.sum()}')

# Check the distribution of customer_age
print(f'Age distribution: {df["customer_age"].value_counts().sort_index()}')

# Check revenue format
print(f'Unique revenue values (first 10): {df["revenue"].unique()[:10]}')"}
